steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/ink/"* . && rm -rf s && bash prep.sh && cat build_info.json | head -c 1500

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ink.blend -P ink_render.py -- stills 50 31,81,163,226,323,389,439,489,551,616,651,763,866,916,1039,1083,1176,1263,1339,1401,1426,1489,1531,1601 > st.log 2>&1; grep -a FRAME st.log | tr '\n' ' '; a="build_info.json ink/e1/build_info.json"; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f ink/e1/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
